name: Urgency Indicators
summary: Passive urgency message with low-stock, selling-fast, viewers, or recent-sale visual treatment selected from truthful target data.

anatomy.name: lowStockIndicator
anatomy.description: Generated visual pulse used by the low-stock presentation.

anatomy.name: sellingFastIcon
anatomy.description: Optional visual icon in the selling-fast presentation.

anatomy.name: emphasis
anatomy.description: Optional textual emphasis within the viewers presentation.

variants.name: low-stock
variants.description: Warning-family presentation for a truthful low-stock claim; the required semantic property prevents this registry default marker from becoming an inferred data default.

variants.name: selling-fast
variants.description: Error-family presentation for a truthful selling-fast claim.

variants.name: viewers
variants.description: Neutral presentation for a truthful current-viewer claim.

variants.name: recent-sale
variants.description: Neutral presentation for a truthful recent-sale claim.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive message presentation; variant classes represent meaning, not interaction state.

states.name: animatedCue
states.description: Optional motion cue disabled when reduced motion is requested.

behavior.name: truthfulTargetData
behavior.description: The target supplies and verifies the message and its semantic presentation; the source contract does not define thresholds, viewer counting, sale recency, or a runtime default.

properties.name: message
properties.description: Visible, self-contained urgency statement supplied from truthful target data.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Explicit semantic treatment selected from target data; required so the contract does not infer an urgency default.

accessibility: Communicate the complete claim in text and do not rely on color, icon, or motion alone.
Do not expose unverified stock, sales, or viewer claims.
Keep the indicator passive and out of the keyboard focus order.
Disable pulse animation when the user requests reduced motion.

web.notes: Visual treatments are implemented; thresholds, data truth, and runtime defaults remain target-owned and unresolved.
